shown.message:
I changed Section 5.4 so the true-curvature result reads as the block's, as `story-repo` asked in #23. It is pushed to `dev` and `candidate-draft-9`, and I commented on #23 and closed it. My local build keeps the main text to 9 pages, with References on page 10 and no undefined references. I have not checked the official `document` build.

The sentence now says the interval has about the oracle's width and covers 0.91 of the block's smooth cells, against 0.90 for HC0 widened to the same width. It adds that on the original cells 0.90 is not reached. I also changed "666 new cells" to "666 cells" to make room, so the main text still ends on page 9.

Still open:
- **`gnn_cells.csv`:** it has not arrived from `experiment-repo`.
- **`main`→`release` pull request:** I haven't opened it. I'll open it when `gnn_cells.csv` is in, or once it is clear it won't land.
